inventoryReview: All64 interactive-screen item IDs derived from own detailed F01/F02/F03/F04/F06 tables are present; F05 nineteen workbook items belong to report tests, not an invented sixth application screen.
All32 input/checkbox labels are independently derived from TextBox/Select/CheckBox rows. F01 explicit for associations use sp2-login-id/sp2-login-pw; other fields use their specified item IDs.

Shell/title/current location/user/links, both actual F04 TabPanels and TabButtons, parent identity, group headings, table headers and matched cell collections, discard dialog child title/message/buttons and error collections are explicit components.

202 of204 components are font-bearing. F04-I12 TabList delegates its text to the two font-tested TabButtons; F06-I06 checkbox glyph delegates text to its separately font-tested associated label. These two exclusions do not exempt visible application labels.

Version3.3 explicitly inventories28 supplemental components: help/skip links/navigation disclosure, explicit reread, export cancellation, generic confirmation choices, search error summary and shared normal-GET error shell children. All get their adopted role fonts; no new business field or screen purpose is introduced.

Every matched member must be measured in its declared state. Taking only the first row/member or averaging disagreements is forbidden. This is a requirement for downstream inventory completeness, not an observation that it is already complete.
individualExpectedValuesReviewed: All rules have unique safe IDs, existing targets and own frozen source references; property names and operators are valid for fixed schema1 scalar validator. All five kinds are represented, and every interaction has a procedure and evidence requirement.

Font family and role values16/24/18/14px match adopted body/input/title/group/UI tokens; twelve individually adopted field widths and minimum40px controls are distinct from narrow-layout max-width behavior.
DUI05 covers untouched raw4 cancel, old-applied invalidation, unknown select placeholder, full server raw comparison and New-save return without automatic search.
DUI06 covers0/200/201/no partial results/no paging/stable order and Success-only applied search restoration with valid selection/scroll.
DUI07/08 distinguish current unreflected career plus whole employee save, DB0 reflection, atomic save/known rollback, current raw/tab/selection retention, invalid cancel and one-code scope.
DUI09 requires natural DOM order, readonly copy, true tab and dialog keyboard behavior, IME composition and multiline Enter/no duplicate submission; F03 Excel precedes list in ordinary DOM order.

DUI11 separately covers five history states, search-only BFCache, independent copied tabs/live state, old lease/UI expiry, authentication priority and Committed versus Unknown without automatic retry.

DQA-UI05 adds nine scalar transport expectations: JSON protected POST, status200 envelope, exactly one navigation GET/ticket consumption, no redirect-follow, failed-save GET document retention/reload Save0, malformed response raw retention and no automatic Save retries.

DUI09.busy-input requires employee/career/code controls to refuse waiting-time edits while retaining pre-request raw and original disabled/readonly states; saved DB must match captured data. F03 New and row edit links visibly/semantically disable while busy.

DUI11.get-errors separately requires ordinary GET HTML/shared Japanese shell and usable next action with403/404/410, no raw JSON, and saved014+041 distinct from Unknown. API JSON error responses continue to preserve current DOM.
DUI12 distinguishes one saved employee/two sheets/all careers/search-state preservation/download start from client save completion. Actual workbook and DB correctness remain report/runtime tests.

UI-C03: all five NARROW rules explicitly require1366/1280/768/390/320 at768px high and text200% at1366. Every environment requires individual overflow0 and major-action reachability; protected nav reachability must hold in each case, with separate geometry/screenshot/action evidence. Real browser zoom and OS DPI evidence remain separate.

findings.issue: Five NARROW rules omitted required1280/768 and did not explicitly demand every environment for aggregated actions/nav.
findings.resolution: Version3.2 names all six required cases including1366 baseline, adds individual overflow expectations and per-case action/nav evidence; independent test checks the exact adopted matrix. Expectations were not derived from measurements.
